mentions.name: The Automated Operator
mentions.description: A Substack newsletter documenting the process of automating Amazon e-commerce operations with AI. Posts cover specific automations in detail, such as a Google Apps Script that uses Gemini to screen inbound emails from prospective acquisition targets and evaluate the listings daily.
mentions.source_excerpt: I also started a Substack to document it - here's a recent post on using Gemini to screen inbound emails with prospective acquisition targets via a Google Apps Script that evaluates the listings in those emails daily: https://theautomatedoperator.substack.com/p/screening-inbound-emails-with-gemini
